description: Hi we are Art of patience.
summary: We made an animation that tells the story about abandon equipment on moon and mars. Out animated video aim to make people remember the equipment in outer space. It is important because these spacecraft help us alot in the exploration of space.
details: Our project aim to teach people about the spacecraft left on the Moon and Mars. We hope that when veiwers watch out animation, it could make them understand the importance of these spacecraft. For the illustration, We use Firealpaca. For editing, We use AviUtl. For music, We use OpenMPT. For the voice, we use Text To Speech which is the only SI tool We used. Our project is creative because we made the animation and music by ourselves. The factor our team consider is that we prepare a tidy schedule and make sure we didn't waste any time.
